# Skye K. Johnson, BsPH

## Public Health Scholar \| Aspiring Epidemiologist

![](images/Headshot.png){fig-alt="Photo of Skye Johnson, an African American women with long black hair,  a black blazer and white blouse with three bows going down, and a grey background." fig-align="center" width="300"}

It is nice to meet you! I am a Master of Public Health student with interest in epidemiology, environmental health, health equity, and data science. My work focuses on examining population health patterns through data to inform public health decision-making and health outcomes.
